title: Partner allocation override harness: environment, fixture keys, reason code, evidence and gate are not specified; the map publishes no override operation and no reason field name or outside-panel refusal message
source: 22 Microservice Realignment/Recovery Workbench Microservice Story Template and Rules v1.md §R5.5, §R7.3 and §R9; _work/msr/wp/B-ITG-W4-05.md; 04 User stories/Recovery Workbench User Stories Epics 3 to 8 v3.md RWB-E6-032 lines 12066-12144; _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Technical Specifications by Module v5/Recovery Workbench TSD S9 Partner management v2.md lines 197-244; _work/msr/plan/ownership.json
description: RWB-ITG-E6032-ITG needs three sets of values that no source gives. (a) The SIT environment and base hosts, the fixture layout, the synthetic partners, case and instruction keys, the reason code and its text, the business date, the evidence format and its retention, and the pass or fail gate at the wave entry check. (b) The override has no published operation of its own: the Ownership Map and TSD S9 publish only POST /cases/{caseId}/instructions and GET /partner/instructions for S9, so the override rides on the published placement and the InstructionRequest and PartnerInstruction shapes are not published either, which leaves the request body to be held in the fixture from S9's CON story. (c) The reason field name is not published and the refusal message for a partner outside the panel is not specified at all, so the run asserts 409 and MSG-GEN-001 only where API-S9-002's published error list (401, 403, 404, 409, 422, 503) and VR-S9-004-1 allow it, and invents no message. One placeholder is used in sections 3, 12.2, 12.8, 13 and 15.
evidence: Legacy RWB-E6-032 (User Stories Epics 3 to 8 v3, lines 12066-12144) gives the story, AC1 and AC2, the four data entities, two partner-portal endpoints, SCR-35 and SCR-34, the permission checks, three messages and TC-E6-032-01 to TC-E6-032-04, and states no environment, fixture, key scheme, reason code, evidence format or gate; Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 line 137 (FEAT-PRM-04, prerequisite FEAT-PRM-03 at line 136) and Business Requirements Program v4 line 432 (REQ-S9-003) name the outcome and no harness detail; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 lines 361, 362, 428, 430, 431, 433 and 449 (R-WO-30, R-WO-31, R-UNI-24, R-UNI-26, R-UNI-27, R-UNI-29, R-UNI-45) give the states and the correction pattern and no reason code; FSD S9 v3 A2.4 lines 328-408 gives VR-S9-004-1 with MSG-GEN-001 on 'Required field empty', BR-S9-004 and the field catalogue without naming the reason field, and the two exception criteria AC-EXC-S9-004-01 and AC-EXC-S9-004-02 without a message for an outside-panel partner; TSD S9 v2 lines 197-244 gives API-S9-002 as 'Issue an instruction to a partner by rule' with purpose, right C, Idempotency-Key and the six errors, and publishes neither the InstructionRequest shape nor a reason field; Arch v5 lines 1245-1256 and 1270-1272, slide 41 line 2891 and slide 43 row 20 line 2946 give the contract, the schema and the event and no harness; Temporal and Drools design slide 25 lines 1663-1755, line 1739, states 'Partner manager: overrides need a reason' and no field name; ownership.json names S9 as owner of both partner operations and of partner and partner_instruction, P3 of the case, P7 of the decision log and P4 of the session, and names no harness artefact; Template and Rules v1 §R7.3 lists the fill order and none of its sources holds these values.
area: Integration harness configuration and unpublished override contract detail
proposed: Agree at the wave 4 entry check: SIT and the base hosts, the fixture layout and the synthetic partners, case, instruction and reason keys, the evidence format and retention, and a gate in which a stub pass is never a real pass. Publish the InstructionRequest and PartnerInstruction shapes with S9's CON story and name the reason field and any outside-panel refusal message there; until then the harness holds the request in the fixture, drives the override through the one published placement and asserts only the published status codes.
